settings.text: Interested in a career in the golf industry? Located in Tacoma, Washington, we're always on the lookout for new skills and personalities to add to the team. Check out current job postings below and how to apply to be a part of team TRUE.

settings.heading: Authentic
settings.item_text: At TRUE, we're the best version of ourselves we can be. We strive to have an inclusive, exciting, and unique experience both in the office and out on the course.

settings.heading: Driven
settings.item_text: We're all motivated by one thing - continued growth both personally and professionally. We aim to continue learning, developing and challenging each other.

settings.heading: Passionate
settings.item_text: There's no question - we love golf. We're also passionate about our product, customers, and each other. Everything we do, we do for a reason and aim to encourage, motivate, and excite each other in pursuit of our passions.

settings.heading: Customer Care & Ops Specialist
settings.overlay_description: The Customer Care and Ops role is one of the best ways to learn all aspects of the business while connecting directly with our customers. This position works closely with all departments to ensure all customer inquiries and daily operations are handled with the utmost attention and care. This role and department are in the best position for future growth opportunities within the business. This position is full-time in Tacoma, WA, and reports to the Director of Experience. To apply, submit your resume to careers@truelinkswear.com. View Job →

settings.heading: Warehouse Specialist
settings.overlay_description: Primary responsibilities include supporting the inbound inventory and processing returns returns department with reviewing, cleaning, and organizing product. As a growing business, we are looking for a “doer” that can aid our warehouse team with inventory organization, order fulfillment, and daily warehouse operations. The Warehouse Specialist will be a crucial part of the Warehouse team and must be able to be diligent, adapt, and maintain a positive attitude while dealing with a variety of responsibilities. This position is full time, reports to the Operations Manager, and is located in Tacoma, WA. Apply Now →
